Title: No secrets from the magaji question

Messages.Author: dome
Messages.Body:
No Secrets From the Magaji
Type: Action
Requires: magaji
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready magaji.
Put this card on this magaji and untap him or her. The magaji with this
card gets +1 intercept when attempting to block vampires. If this magaji
is tapped, he or she may attempt to block a vampire as if untapped. Burn
this card if this magaji attempts to block a vampire but is not
successful. A vampire may have only one No Secrets From the Magaji.

If a magaji can attempt to block, can he play reaction cards (can
casewayo play quicken sight when attempting to block tapped?) or not?

I'm guessing no, but not quite sure.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Right. He'd need a wake or some other effect to play reaction cards while tapped.

Messages.Body:
